churn_definition: Customer made zero non-cancelled purchase invoices in the 180-day future window after the prediction cutoff.
kmeans_k_rationale: K=2 had the highest silhouette score (0.465), but K=4 was selected for business interpretability because it isolated a distinct 101-customer high-value bulk/wholesale-like cluster (Cluster 3) that K=2/K=3 blend into the general high-value group.
excluded_from_customer_master: 53 cancellation-only customers and any customer with no purchase in the observation period are excluded from customer-level RFM/churn tables, per Stage 3-5 methodology.
